say:2:1410510001:1.text: Merlin, I can't believe you were using me all along! You... you... wicked! Selfish! Meanie!
say:2:1410510001:1.source_cn: 梅林！原来你一直在利用我！阴险！残忍！恶毒！冷酷！
say:2:1410510001:1.male: Merlin, I can't believe you were using me all along! You... you... wicked! Selfish! Meanie!
say:2:1410510001:1.female: Merlin, I can't believe you were using me all along! You... you... wicked! Selfish! Meanie!

say:3:1410510002:1.text: Alright, kiddo. Help us get the lift going, and we'll let you go. Sound good?
say:3:1410510002:1.source_cn: 喂，小子，你帮我们启动升降机，我们就放你一马，怎么样？

say:4:1410510003:1.text: How rude! I have a name, and it's Feli!
say:4:1410510003:1.source_cn: 粗鲁的矮人，我叫斐利尔！

say:5:1410510004:1.text: Do I look like I care? Here's the deal—if you don't help us now, when we get caught, we'll say you led us right to the ritual site.
say:5:1410510004:1.source_cn: 管你叫什么，你要是不肯合作，等我们被抓到，就说你是幕后...

say:6:1410510005:1.text: Just use that little brain of yours and think. You and Indris led him to the ritual site... Who's going to believe you're innocent?
say:6:1410510005:1.source_cn: 想想看，因度厄和你带<male>他</male><fe...
say:6:1410510005:1.male: Just use that little brain of yours and think. You and Indris led him to the ritual site... Who's going to believe you're innocent?
say:6:1410510005:1.female: Just use that little brain of yours and think. You and Indris led her to the ritual site... Who's going to believe you're innocent?

say:7:1410510006:1.text: How can you do this?! You're just twisting everything around! I'm the real victim here!
say:7:1410510006:1.source_cn: 怎么能这样！你们、你们太阴险了，我是受害者啊！

say:8:1410510007:1.text: But, if you help us with the lift, we'll make sure you stay clean even if we're caught.
say:8:1410510007:1.source_cn: 但如果你帮我们启动升降机，我们就算被抓到，也绝对不会把...

say:9:1410510008:1.text: We'll say you fought back, tried to stop us. Who knows, maybe you'll even get a medal for your efforts!
say:9:1410510008:1.source_cn: 我们会渲染你是如何努力反抗，坚贞不屈，说不定你还能捞个...

say:10:1410510009:1.text: Indris' future, yours—it all hangs on this choice! Pick wisely!
say:10:1410510009:1.source_cn: 因度厄的命运和你自己的将来，就在你的一念之间！快给我选！

choice_prompt:11:1410510009.text: Indris' future, yours—it all hangs on this choice! Pick wisely!
choice_prompt:11:1410510009.source_cn: 因度厄的命运和你自己的将来，就在你的一念之间！快给我选！

say:12:1410510010:1.text: Oh, honey, I've been around long enough to know exactly how to deal with this nonsense!
say:12:1410510010:1.source_cn: 我活这么多年，不是白活的！
say:12:1410510010:1.male: Oh, honey, I've been around long enough to know exactly how to deal with this nonsense!
say:12:1410510010:1.female: Oh, honey, I've been around long enough to know exactly how to deal with this nonsense!

say:13:1410510011:1.text: By the way, in addition to tinkering with inventions, I'm also an expert at giving people a good whack!
say:13:1410510011:1.source_cn: 臭小子，你听好了，除了搞发明， 祖奶奶我最擅长的事情就...

say:14:1410510012:1.text: Get that lift started, or I'll beat you into doing it!
say:14:1410510012:1.source_cn: 要么你赶紧启动电梯，要么我揍到你启动电梯！你掂量掂量自...

say:15:1410510013:1.text: Well... but I can't guarantee I can get it to work...
say:15:1410510013:1.source_cn: 那……那我……但是！我也不一定能启动啊！

say:16:1410510014:1.text: Don't worry, just give it a shot. We won't blame you if it doesn't work.
say:16:1410510014:1.source_cn: 放心吧，你试一试，打开打不开都算我们的，可以吧？

say:17:1410510015:1.text: Fine... I'll give it a try.
